## Results
### CRISOT-Score provides effective off-target scoring of Cas9 system
#### Comprehensive evaluations of CRISOT-Score
The average frequencies summarized in Fig. [4g](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-023-42695-4#Fig4) showed that the frequencies of active off-targets at CRISOT-Score ranges greater than 0.8 were higher than 0.9, and the frequencies of active off-targets at CRISOT-Score ranges lower than 0.5 were almost 0.

### CRISOT-Spec provides effective sgRNA targeting specificity evaluation of Cas9 system
As shown in Fig. [5a](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-023-42695-4#Fig5), the fractions of active off-targets were almost zero when the CRISOT-Score values were less than 0.5, while were almost one when CRISOT-Score higher than 0.85.
